Thanks Jorge — good questions. Short answers:

- Activation trigger: PO + acceptance of the CPPO order form / SOW. We attach the standard CPPO order form to this thread and can accept signatures via DocuSign. Once we have the signed order form and PO number we schedule entitlement provisioning.
- SLA for entitlements: our target is 3 business days from confirmed PO + signed order form for standard SKUs. For any custom entitlement mapping we allow up to 7 business days.
- Demo credit splits: yes, we can apportion the demo credits across business units — we'll note that allocation in the SOW as a table.

Operational notes for our side: Vanessa will be your go-to for onboarding and entitlement validation. Soojin will own the technical feed/manifest to the marketplace listing and will need a short JSON mapping from your billing identifiers. Ben — would you be able to coordinate a Friday 30-min ops walkthrough (calendar invite) with CloudLayer?

I'll attach the CPPO order form and a one-page SOW template by end of day.

Thanks,
Priyom
